items.title: Nordics weigh merging their stock exchanges into one regional market
items.summary: A group of the Nordic region's largest companies and investors is examining whether Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland could combine their national stock exchanges into a single regional marketplace in an effort to deepen liquidity and win more listings.View on euronews
